hero.title: Tilak Dhari P.G. College, Jaunpur
hero.summary: Agriculture at T.D. College sits within a long-established Jaunpur college, with undergraduate study and postgraduate routes across crop production, economics, extension and plant protection. Its agriculture departments give students a subject-based academic setting within a college affiliated to Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University.

overview.heading: Agriculture departments within a historic Jaunpur college
paragraphs: T.D. College traces its origins to a school founded by Sri Tilak Dhari Singh in 1914; its own history dates degree-college status to July 1947. Located in Husainabad, Jaunpur, it is a privately managed grant-in-aid college affiliated to Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University. The founding year therefore describes the institution’s origins rather than the start of degree-level agriculture.

The agriculture faculty spans agronomy, genetics and plant breeding, agricultural economics, engineering, entomology, extension, horticulture, plant pathology, animal husbandry and soil science. The undergraduate agriculture degree is complemented by six postgraduate specialisms in the ICAR register. Applicants interested in a particular specialism can compare the departmental faculty list and the current entrance bulletin before choosing a route.

admissions.heading: Applying to T.D. College
admissions.intro: The college links an Entrance Test 2026 menu to its registration portal. Its bulletin link opened a 2025-titled document; obtain the operative 2026–27 agriculture rules before applying.
eligibility_points: The older official Extension page describes a four-year B.Sc. and a two-year extension master’s programme; these duration statements do not establish current seat availability.

steps.title: Check the agriculture bulletin
steps.text: Use the college’s entrance-test and new-registration links, and obtain the bulletin for the intended admission session.

steps.title: Confirm the specialism and entry rules
steps.text: Ask the college to confirm the agriculture subject combination, minimum marks, current intake and programme-specific counselling notice.

campus.heading: Agricultural teaching and practical work
campus.intro: The Plant Pathology department’s September 2022 account describes research work at the college’s Pili Kothi Farm and in its laboratory, with supervised investigations in field and laboratory conditions. These are documented departmental resources; their current allocation should be confirmed with the college.

faqs.question: Is T.D. College a university?
faqs.answer: It is an affiliated college. The audited entry identifies Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University as its parent university; the college remains the teaching institution.

faqs.question: Does 1914 mark the start of degree courses?
faqs.answer: No. The history traces the institution to a school established in 1914 and dates degree-college status to July 1947.

faqs.question: Which agriculture master’s subjects are listed by ICAR?
faqs.answer: The audited scope covers agronomy, agricultural economics, agricultural extension education, entomology, genetics and plant breeding, and plant pathology. Each printed master’s intake is 20. These are accreditation entries rather than live vacancy figures.

faqs.question: Why do agriculture degree names and seats differ between pages?
faqs.answer: The ICAR row prints B.S. (Hons). Agriculture with intake 240, while the older department page calls it B.Sc. (Ag) Hons. and shows 220. The current entrance bulletin should settle the name and seats offered for an admission session.

faqs.question: Where can applicants contact the college?
faqs.answer: The official contact page gives Husainabad, Jaunpur 222002, phone +91 7068319555 and principaltdc1914@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Are current agriculture fees published in this draft?
faqs.answer: No. The official fee page displayed an image without a readable year-specific agriculture table. A dated fee schedule is needed to separate tuition, examination and other charges.
